verdict.rationale: MailerSend is a hosted transactional email SaaS, and whether its source is published under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the product's source is published or open-licensed. The mention of official client libraries does not establish open-licensed product source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
